sentence: Community-based rural road maintenance was technically and operationally feasible, but its success depended critically on strong institutional and fiduciary delivery chains, including predictable financing, streamlined contract management, and timely payment systems.

passages.40130174:81: Lesson 1 - Community-based rural road maintenance can be successfully implemented at scale, but only when supported by predictable and adequate arrangements. The project demonstrated that labor-intensive, community-based maintenance is technically and operationally feasible in the Moroccan context, but that implementation performance depends critically on the strength of the institutional and fiduciary delivery chain, including in terms of financing arrangements, streamlined contract management, and timely payment systems. This experience suggests that future operations should move beyond treating community-based maintenance as a stand-alone pilot activity and instead embed it within established and predictable maintenance financing mechanisms. Clear and streamlined contractual arrangements, simplified payment procedures, stable supervision responsibilities, and early assessment of the capacity and availability of local micro-enterprises are essential to scale up this model successfully. The project also demonstrates that decentralized and multi-institutional pilots require significantly longer start-up periods than conventional infrastructure operations and should allocate sufficient time for institutional preparation, coordination, and capacity building before field activities begin.
